references.text: In the beginning was the Word...
By the word of the LORD were the heavens made...
Through faith we understand that the worlds were framed...
For by him were all things created...
Thou art worthy, O Lord, to receive glory and honour...
By the word of the LORD...
I beheld the earth, and, lo, it was without form, and void...
For God, who commanded the light to shine out of darkness...
For he spake, and it was done...
In the day that God created man, in the likeness of God made he him...
Whoso sheddeth man's blood, by man shall his blood be shed: for in the image of God made he man...
And that ye put on the new man, which after God is created in righteousness and true holiness.
And have put on the new man, which is renewed in knowledge after the image of him that created him.
Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Before Abraham was, I am.
Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and to day, and for ever.
Grace be unto you... from him which is, and which was, and which is to come.
I am the LORD thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt...
I have not sat with vain persons, neither will I go in with dissemblers.
Enter not into the path of the wicked, and go not in the way of evil men.
He shall feed his flock like a shepherd...
I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep.
Now the God of peace, that brought again from the dead our Lord Jesus, that great shepherd of the sheep...
For ye were as sheep going astray; but are now returned unto the Shepherd and Bishop of your souls.
For in the time of trouble he shall hide me in his pavilion...
Thou art my hiding place; thou shalt preserve me from trouble...
Behold, a virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel...
And, behold, thou shalt conceive in thy womb, and bring forth a son, and shalt call his name JESUS.
For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.
For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son...
Looking for that blessed hope, and the glorious appearing of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ.
Who was delivered for our offences, and was raised again for our justification.
For I delivered unto you first of all... how that Christ died for our sins according to the scriptures.
Who his own self bare our sins in his own body on the tree... by whose stripes ye were healed.
Therefore the Lord himself shall give you a sign; Behold, a virgin shall conceive...
For thus saith the high and lofty One... I dwell in the high and holy place... with him also that is of a contrite and humble spirit...
but to this man will I look, even to him that is poor and of a contrite spirit, and trembleth at my word.
And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me...
In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.
That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes...
And he was clothed with a vesture dipped in blood: and his name is called The Word of God.
But God commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
But God, who is rich in mercy, for his great love wherewith he loved us...
In this was manifested the love of God toward us, because that God sent his only begotten Son into the world...
Herein is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son to be the propitiation for our sins.
The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
He shall feed his flock like a shepherd...
Now the God of peace... that great shepherd of the sheep...
Neither is there salvation in any other: for there is none other name under heaven given among men, whereby we must be saved.
For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus.
By a new and living way, which he hath consecrated for us, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh.
And, behold, I send the promise of my Father upon you: but tarry ye in the city of Jerusalem, until ye be endued with power from on high.
Go ye therefore, and teach all nations...
As it is written, There is none righteous, no, not one.
They are all gone aside, they are all together become filthy: there is none that doeth good, no, not one.
But the scripture hath concluded all under sin...
But of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, thou shalt not eat of it: for in the day that thou eatest thereof thou shalt surely die.
For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.
Wherefore, as by one man sin entered into the world, and death by sin...
But as for you, ye thought evil against me; but God meant it unto good...
For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the LORD, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end.
For our light affliction, which is but for a moment, worketh for us a far more exceeding and eternal weight of glory.
And be renewed in the spirit of your mind.
And have put on the new man, which is renewed in knowledge after the image of him that created him.
Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world...
Hatred stirreth up strifes: but love covereth all sins.
And above all things have fervent charity among yourselves: for charity shall cover the multitude of sins.
A new heart also will I give you, and a new spirit will I put within you...
For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision, but a new creature.
For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works...
I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me... bringeth forth much fruit...
For the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth.
Being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus.
Therefore it is of faith, that it might be by grace...
Not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to his mercy he saved us...
And he said unto them, My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness.
for without me ye can do nothing.
For the prophecy came not in old time by the will of man: but holy men of God spake as they were moved by the Holy Ghost.
Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
For we are saved by hope: but hope that is seen is not hope...
While we look not at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen...
For we walk by faith, not by sight.
And God said unto Moses, I AM THAT I AM...
For I am the LORD, I change not; therefore ye sons of Jacob are not consumed.
I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the ending, saith the Lord...
For the LORD giveth wisdom: out of his mouth cometh knowledge and understanding.
Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.
Commit thy way unto the LORD; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.
Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee...
Therefore I say unto you, Take no thought for your life, what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink...
I acknowledged my sin unto thee... and thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin.
He that covereth his sins shall not prosper: but whoso confesseth and forsaketh them shall have mercy.
He will swallow up death in victory; and the Lord GOD will wipe away tears from off all faces...
And the ransomed of the LORD shall return... they shall obtain joy and gladness, and sorrow and sighing shall flee away.
...and God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes.
